ev.q: In 2015, the Oregon Health Authority was notified of the death of a boy with subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE)
The CSF measles IgG was confirmed at CDC’s measles virus laboratory (titer = 1:40,960)
The patient, aged 14 years, had reportedly been vaccinated against measles in the Philippines at age 8 months.

methods_quotes.q: Investigators from the Oregon Health Authority and the Oregon Health and Science University reviewed the patient’s medical records and interviewed the parents.
